title: Pinball Bricks 2999
description: Aim a growing stream of bouncing pinballs across 2,999 numbered brick stages—nail banked top-wall angles to shred hundreds of blocks in one volley.
controls: Drag to aim your dotted trajectory line, then release to fire a stream of bouncing balls that chip down numbered bricks.

zh-CN.title: 数字弹球大闯关
zh-CN.description: 超耐玩 2999 关经典物理弹球消砖块：一指拉线找准黄金反弹死角，几十颗弹球连环撞击清光满屏数字砖块超解压！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动瞄准虚线角度后松手发射弹球串，利用多次反弹清空所有数字砖块。
